document: Gate 3-B.4 tasks 11-13: second-annotator plan, revised Gate 3-C design (not executed), paper revisions

gold_authority.note: Single-annotator gold carried unchanged from Gate 3-A.1; no second adjudicator has been obtained as of Gate 3-B.4. No Cohen kappa is reported and gold is never called human-adjudicated. Gate 3-B.4 audits model behaviour against this PROVISIONAL gold only; the same AI operator performing the audit is NOT an independent human adjudicator.

agreement_and_adjudication.disagreement_path: any ACCEPT/REJECT mismatch, or either party NEEDS_REVIEW, goes to a THIRD senior human arbiter who sees both independent labels but not the model outputs; the arbiter records a reason and the final label
agreement_and_adjudication.measure: raw agreement + Cohen kappa on ACCEPT/REJECT (treat NEEDS_REVIEW as a third category or exclude with the rule pre-stated)
agreement_and_adjudication.no_silent_override: the final gold set records annotator1, annotator2, arbiter labels and the reason for every changed label

annotator_selection.competence: familiar with Python/SymPy test semantics (FAIL_TO_PASS / PASS_TO_PASS, xfail, flaky tests)
annotator_selection.independence: a human annotator who has NOT seen any model output, the G3-A/G3-B analyses, or the existing gold; separate institution/team preferred
annotator_selection.no_ai_arbitration: an LLM or the pipeline author must not be used as annotator2 or as the tie-break

blind_packet_assignment: For each of the 10 (later: Gate 3-C N) issues build a packet containing ONLY: problem statement, base commit, candidate patch, maintainer test_patch, and the raw CI log (f2p, p2p, p2p_baseline). Remove all model verdicts/reasons, coverage summaries and prior labels.
Randomise packet order with a fresh seed; label packets P01.., never by issue number; keep the mapping in a sealed file.

Give annotator2 the SAME written decision rubric annotator1 used (ACCEPT iff every declared F2P transitions fail->pass and no declared P2P regresses; REJECT if a decisive applicable failure/regression is shown; mark any genuinely un-decidable packet NEEDS_REVIEW rather than forcing a label).
task11_second_annotator_plan.current_gold_status: PROVISIONAL, single annotator (n=1); annotator2 = NOT_OBTAINED for all 10 issues
task11_second_annotator_plan.deliverable_before_gate_3c_claims: human annotator2 labels + adjudication + sensitivity table must exist before any paper claim that depends on gold correctness is stated as fact
sensitivity_analysis_on_gold_flips: Recompute every headline rate (DeepSeek need-any 1/10 residual, GPT strict unsupported-accept 7/10, focal-family cases) under (a) annotator1 labels, (b) annotator2 labels, (c) adjudicated labels.

Report how many of the 7 GPT strict "errors" survive if a label flips; if any issue flips ACCEPT<->REJECT, present the rate both with and without that issue (leave-one-issue-out) and as a bounds interval over all plausible adjudications.
Pre-register that a conclusion is "robust" only if its sign holds across all three label sets.
task11_second_annotator_plan.status: PROPOSED ONLY - not executed in Gate 3-B.4
task11_second_annotator_plan.title: Second independent annotator (human) review plan
task11_second_annotator_plan.why_needed: the GPT false-accept rate and the SymPy-13974 residual both rest on gold labels produced by one annotator; an AI re-read is not independent adjudication

budget_estimate.hard_caps_required: per-model and total pre-call budget caps with the repaired CompositeGuard, plus a mock gate before any paid run
budget_estimate.illustration_not_approved: at the observed mean, a design of 40 issues x 5 conditions x 2 models = 400 cells would cost on the order of 400 * mean (plus the two extra arms), before any cap; this is a PLANNING figure only and is NOT approved in Gate 3-B.4, which spends $0

task12_gate3c_revised_design.current_limitation: independent REJECT issues are only n=3 (17318, 17630, 19783); GPT false-accept and the relevance-relitigation error cannot be rate-estimated from three negatives

mechanism_experiment_to_identify_overcom.additional_arm: an active arm that returns the SAME positive signals but with an explicit on-screen reminder that completeness/freshness/symptom-resolution do not imply outcomes, to test whether the over-commitment is a presentational fixable failure
mechanism_experiment_to_identify_overcom.candidate_mechanism: active evidence query inducing over-commitment (currently UNPROVEN)
mechanism_experiment_to_identify_overcom.design: hold freshness and coverage/trust rules FIXED (all fresh=TRUE) and toggle ONLY tool availability: static tier-D vs active strict tier-D, within-issue, both models. This isolates activeness from the G3-B->G3-B.3 freshness/trust confound.

pre_registered_primary_endpoint.analysis: issue-clustered paired differences with exact/bootstrap CIs; no pooling across error families
pre_registered_primary_endpoint.endpoint: unsupported-commitment rate on independent REJECT issues under the sufficient-evidence active condition (ACCEPT when oracle=REJECT), and NEED rate on ACCEPT issues, estimated per model
secondary: strict over-commitment rate (ACCEPT under gold-NEED in the restricted active arm) vs static arm, paired by issue
symptom-only/coverage-only/absence-of-failure reason-code prevalence using the frozen g3b4 codebook

prerequisite_fixes: strip pass_to_pass_baseline at tier D (views._ACCEPTANCE_RECORD_FIELDS) to close the minimisation gap
harden the f2p/p2p identical-file presentation (distinct labels or an explicit combined-run note) to reduce the 13974-type mis-read

sample_expansion.accept_control: retain/refresh ACCEPT issues to keep the design balanced and to re-estimate DeepSeek residual over-abstention
sample_expansion.priority_1_more_independent_reject_issue: add new candidate issues whose frozen CI shows a decisive applicable FAILURE (oracle REJECT), drawn so they are not reused G3-A/G3-B issues and balanced across failure reasons (declared F2P still fails; new regression in P2P; flaky/xfail traps).
sample_expansion.priority_2_genuine_restricted_evidence: evaluate REAL restricted-evidence cases (tier-D withheld outcomes) as a stratified condition, but separate them from gold-ACCEPT/gold-REJECT sufficient-evidence trials so withholding is never conflated with the objective verdict
sample_expansion.reject_target: pre-register a target of at least 20 independent REJECT issues total (>=17 added) so a false-accept RATE among negatives has a usable confidence width

sample_size_and_power.basis: with ~20 independent negatives, the half-width of a Wilson 95% interval for a false-accept proportion is roughly +/-0.2 near p=0.5 and +/-0.15 near p=0.2; exact size to be recomputed against the observed G3-B.3 GPT negative false-accept rate once annotator2 labels exist
sample_size_and_power.paired_design: every issue run in every arm by both models to keep the issue as the independent unit

stopping_rules: hard stop at the pre-approved total USD cap via pre-call bounds (no call that could breach it is issued)
stop and freeze if a protocol-capability drift (silent response_format downgrade / fallback) is detected
stop if the local zero-API live gate or preflight fails
pre-specified interim look at most once; stop for harm only (e.g., a model commits on every negative), never to cherry-pick a favourable result
no expansion beyond the frozen issue list without a new written approval
task12_gate3c_revised_design.title: Revised Gate 3-C design (NOT executed; budget approval separately required)

claims_not_to_make: do not claim strict over-commitment is proven/causal
do not report a GPT false-accept RATE from n=3 negatives
do not present AI self-coding or AI self-review as independent human adjudication
do not treat the all-PASSED baseline-map exposure as a gold leak
discussion_revisions: Add the non-interference finding: post-patch acceptance/regression outcomes and hidden gold were not exposed (tier-1 scan 61/61 clean); disclose the tier-2 minimisation gap (the all-PASSED, zero-discrimination pre-patch pass_to_pass_baseline map survived projection and was seen by one correctly-abstaining GPT cell and by 8 DeepSeek cells) and that it is fixed before Gate 3-C.

State that the blind reason coding was a SINGLE AI, rule-based coding with no independent human coder/review; present it as template characterisation (all 7 errors share provenance+coverage+symptom+absence-of-failure phrasing, C3 primary), not as validated qualitative evidence.

Report operational integrity honestly: the first live attempt failed before any API call due to CompositeGuard.check returning None (float(None) pre-network), was repaired, the $0 products discarded, and the freeze regenerated; the final 100/100 is the post-repair run.
Frame all gold-dependent statements as PROVISIONAL until the human second-annotator review and flip sensitivity analysis are complete.

results_revisions.revised_wording: The originally observed 9/10 over-abstention was substantially driven by PROTOCOL-CONSTRUCT problems in the G3-B instrument (structural fresh=FALSE and the coverage/trust handling), not by a stable model property. After the G3-B.3 corrective replication the paired need-any rate moved 9/10 -> 1/10 (8 need->non-need reversals, 0 reverse; issue-cluster bootstrap 95% CI for the paired difference 0.5-1.0). Report as an ASSOCIATIONAL before/after contrast.

After repair the only residual sufficient-evidence over-abstention is SymPy-13974 (NEED under T2A and T3D-Escalate while ACCEPT under T3A). Fact-checking shows the abstention rests on two wrong readings (a declared acceptance test believed missing that is actually present and passing; three logs believed identical when the baseline differs); classify as a residual model evidence-interpretation/policy error, n=1, gold PROVISIONAL pending annotator2.

GPT false acceptance PERSISTS after the protocol repair (e.g., SymPy-17318 T2A accepts although the declared F2P test failed; active T3A on the same issue rejects). However the independent REJECT sample is only n=3, so report specific cases, not a population rate, and flag the estimate as underpowered pending Gate 3-C.

Under T3D-Strict, GPT returned unsupported ACCEPT on 7/10 gold-NEED cells in G3-B.3 vs 0/10 in G3-B, while both models abstain 10/10 on the static T2D surface and DeepSeek abstains 10/10 even when actively querying. Describe active-evidence-induced over-commitment strictly as a NEW CANDIDATE MECHANISM: the cross-version comparison is confounded (freshness and trust rules changed with activeness), so it must NOT be called demonstrated until the activeness-only controlled experiment is run.
